content.title: Block transfer initiation for frozen_user
content.intent: Prove that the frozen persona cannot perform transfers through ordinary UI actions.
content.technique_notes: Applied auth/permission, negative, and state/flow techniques because the PRD states the frozen persona has an explicit 'no transfers' restriction and that this restriction must not be bypassable through ordinary UI actions. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because money, auth, and data-loss apply, but no covering array was needed because this scenario fixes a single persona-state path.
